$schema_comment: KnoSky DEC-108 / R3-D closed decision-code freeze. Identical list on protocol page, README, wiki, fixtures.
lattice_note: policy-lattice.mjs uses DENY > ALLOW > NOT_APPLICABLE for rule combine. Protocol decision_code on the wire extends that with reason-specific DENY_* and Mode A label.

codes.meaning: Route/list/bundle returned under policy; audit receipt present.
codes.client_hint: Proceed using pointers; still open live files for truth.

codes.meaning: No route; generic policy or authorization denial without subclass.
codes.client_hint: No authorized path; do not probe for hidden structure.

codes.meaning: Missing, unknown, expired/revoked lease, or spoofed agent identity.
codes.client_hint: Register/bind agent + valid lease before governed calls.

codes.meaning: Policy missing, invalid, unsigned when required, or explicit policy DENY.
Ledger write or verify failed; fail closed — no ALLOW payload.
codes.client_hint: Check disk/permissions for audit ledger; retry later.

codes.meaning: Map or evidence stale when freshness required.
Required security evidence failed (e.g. lockdown/evidence profile requirement).
codes.client_hint: Run knosky doctor; satisfy profile evidence or choose a lower claim profile.
Fix tool arguments; see validation details (non-oracle).
Build or repair local map index.

codes.meaning: Explicit Mode A non-governed advisory navigation. Not authorized, not policy-certified, not swarm-safe.
codes.client_hint: Treat as structural tips only; verify before acting; do not claim governance.

rules: No open-string decision codes on the wire.
Mode B terminal ALLOW requires receipt_id.
All DENY_* and DENY must set metadata_disclosed=false for restricted data.
ADVISORY_UNAUTH must appear on Mode A route responses.
Pack smoke fixtures snapshot this closed_set.
CI gate: unknown code in responses fails release.
